title: Valid bracket sequence
prompt: Specification: Return True if and only if the string consists only of the characters (), {}, [] and every opening bracket is closed by the matching type in the correct order. The implementation below should satisfy this specification for all valid inputs. Does it? Answer COMPLIANT or NOT_COMPLIANT.

evidence.title: A test that exposes the defect
evidence.body:
Test: assert is_valid_parenthese("(") == False
Expected: False
Actual: True

recommendation.text: The implementation does not satisfy the specification.
